## `langwatch/api-context-services`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: isFeatureApi
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-api-context-services.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `construction`
  - what: `new {{name}}` inside an API class.
  - fix: Take it from `context.app` and let the composition root construct it.
- `contextCast`
  - what: API context is already typed; do not cast it to recover application services.
  - fix: Remove the cast and use `context` directly.
- `doubleAwait`
  - what: Await one service call; do not await a resolver and then await the service operation.
  - fix: Collapse to a single `await`.
- `resolver`
  - what: API options are static configuration, not per-request callbacks.
  - fix: Use context.app, context.actor(), context.authorize(), and validated input.

## `langwatch/awaited-return-chain`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: applies
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-awaited-return-chain.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `awaitedReturnChain`
  - what: Name the awaited result before chaining properties or calls from it.
  - fix: Assign the awaited value to a const, then chain from the const.

## `langwatch/banned-legacy-names`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-banned-legacy-names.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `bannedLegacyName`
  - what: `{{name}}` was deleted.
  - fix: Instead, {{instead}}.
  - why: A deleted builder left in a file is not a compile error until the file is reached, so it survives every check that runs on something else.

## `langwatch/boolean-wall`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-boolean-wall.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `booleanWall`
  - what: This condition has {{leaves}} leaf tests; the maximum is 3.
  - fix: Assign a group of them to a named const and test the name.

## `langwatch/channel-takes-only-its-client`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: isChannel
- Fixable: no
- Spec: none yet

Options: none.

Messages:

- `channelTakesMoreThanItsClient`
  - what: A channel names {{crossed}} (`{{specifier}}`).
  - fix: Take the client alone and let the service that owns the decision call this channel.
  - why: A channel takes the client it speaks to. State is the repository's, behaviour is the app's, and a channel that reads either becomes a second app nobody looks in.

## `langwatch/cognitive-complexity`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-cognitive-complexity.feature`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max` | integer | `15` | — |

Messages:

- `tooComplex`
  - what: `{{name}}` has cognitive complexity {{complexity}}; the maximum is {{max}}.
  - fix: Extract the deepest branch into a named function, or replace the if/else chain with an early return or lookup table.

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-comment-block-size.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `commentColumns`
  - what: Comment line is {{width}} columns; wrap at {{max}}.
  - fix: Rewrap the block at {{max}} columns, or cut it to the sentence that earns its place.

## `langwatch/comment-block-size-warning`

- Kind: style
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-comment-block-size-warning.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `commentBlockSize`
  - what: Comment block has {{lines}} lines; the maximum is {{max}}.
  - fix: Keep one or two lines of why beside the code and move the narrative into an ADR or a dev/docs page this comment links; delete it outright when the code already says it. More than one block in a file is a sweep, not an edit: list them with `pnpm exec oxlint --config .oxlintrc.architecture.json <file>` and hand that list to a haiku subagent to rewrite in one pass.

## `langwatch/condition-shape`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-condition-shape.feature`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `maxCalls` | integer | `1` | — |
| `maxHops` | integer | `2` | — |
| `maxOperators` | integer | `2` | — |

Messages:

- `nameCondition`
  - what: This condition takes {{hops}} property hops, {{calls}} calls and {{operators}} logical operators to read.
  - fix: Name it: assign it to a const and test the name.
  - why: A test nobody can read at a glance is where the wrong branch hides.

## `langwatch/conditional-type-depth`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: isOverengineeringFile
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-conditional-type-depth.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `stateTheShape`
  - what: {{message}}
  - fix: {{allowed}}
  - why: A type this deep re-computes what a plain interface or discriminated union already says.

## `langwatch/dangling-barrel-export`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-dangling-barrel-export.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `danglingImport`
  - what: `{{specifier}}` is imported here but no file of that name exists.
  - fix: Point the import at the file's new path, or delete the line if the file is gone. These arrive in batches from one in-flight move: resolve the whole file in one pass rather than a line at a time.
  - why: A stale `dist/*.d.ts` keeps diagnostics green, so only a test run finds it.
- `danglingReexport`
  - what: `{{specifier}}` is re-exported here but no file of that name exists.
  - fix: Point the re-export at the file's new path, or delete the line if the file is gone. These arrive in batches from one in-flight move: resolve the whole barrel in one pass rather than a line at a time.
  - why: A stale `dist/*.d.ts` keeps diagnostics green, so only a test run finds it.

## `langwatch/empty-catch`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-empty-catch.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `emptyCatch`
  - what: `{{form}}` swallows the failure without saying so.
  - fix: Rethrow it, log it with the trace id, or return the value the caller gets when this fails.

## `langwatch/environment-boundaries`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-environment-boundaries.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `environment`
  - what: Do not read `process.env` here.
  - fix: Parse it in `platform/config/` or a `*.composition.ts` file and pass the typed value in.

## `langwatch/fallible-result-naming`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: isFallibleResultModule
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-fallible-result-naming.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `noResultType`
  - what: `{{name}}` has no explicit result type, so its absence contract cannot be enforced.
  - fix: Add an explicit return type.
- `nullableWithoutFind`
  - what: `{{name}}` can return null/undefined, but only a `find*` method may answer with absence.
  - fix: Throw the domain error and drop the nullable from the type, or name it `find*`.
- `requirePrefix`
  - what: Rename `{{name}}`: drop the `require` prefix; a method already returns or throws.
  - fix: Rename the method without the `require` prefix.
- `tryPrefix`
  - what: `{{name}}` hedges: a `try` method hands the caller a maybe instead of an answer.
  - fix: Name it `{{plain}}` and throw the domain error when it cannot answer; if absence is a normal outcome the caller branches on, name it `find*` and return undefined.

## `langwatch/feature-module-classes`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-feature-module-classes.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `abstract`
  - what: A strict feature port module must export an abstract {{suffix}} class.
  - fix: Export an abstract `*{{suffix}}` class.
- `concrete`
  - what: A strict feature runtime module must export a concrete {{suffix}} class.
  - fix: Export a concrete `*{{suffix}}` class.
- `create`
  - what: A concrete strict feature class must expose construction through static create.
  - fix: Add a static `create` method.
- `standalone`
  - what: Exported function in `{{path}}`: a `{{suffix}}` module keeps behaviour on its class.
  - fix: Move it onto the class or into `rules/`.

## `langwatch/feature-side-holds-no-app`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-feature-side-holds-no-app.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `implementsApi`
  - what: Class `{{name}}` implements the contract type `{{contract}}`.
  - fix: Move this class into the owning module's server package as its `<Name>App`; the process side keeps an installer, a mount and a composition.
- `reservedName`
  - what: Class `{{name}}` is named like a module app (`*Api`, `*App`, `*Delegate`, `Extended*`).
  - fix: Move this class into the owning module and let its installer boot it; the process side holds installers, mounts and compositions only.

## `langwatch/feature-source-filename`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-feature-source-filename.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `filename`
  - what: `{{name}}` is not `<subject>.<artifact>.ts` in lower kebab case.
  - fix: Rename it after the subject and the artifact, e.g. `trace-search.service.ts`; the artifacts are {{artifacts}}.

## `langwatch/feature-source-layout`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-feature-source-layout.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `contractFilename`
  - what: Rename `{{name}}` to `<subject>.<artifact>.ts` in lower kebab case, e.g. `trace-search.service.ts`.
  - fix: Use one of the canonical contract artifacts.
- `contractMissingSubject`
  - what: Rename `{{name}}` to `<subject>.{{artifact}}.ts`, e.g. `agent.commands.ts`.
  - fix: Add the subject to the filename.
- `contractServerArtifact`
  - what: Server artifact {{name}} cannot live in contract source.
  - fix: Move it to `server/src/<dir>/`.
- `processManagerService`
  - what: Rename `{{path}}` to `processes/<subject>.process.ts`; a process manager is not a service.
  - fix: Move the file to `processes/` and rename its `.service.ts` suffix to `.process.ts`.
- `rulesImpurity`
  - what: Rules module {{path}} may only export functions and constants (found {{found}}).
  - fix: Move the class or `new` into a service or adapter and pass its result in.
- `serverPath`
  - what: `{{path}}` has no home in layout v0. Only this shape is allowed: index.ts, <feature>.server.ts, app/<feature>.app.ts, transport/<feature>.<rest|trpc|ws>.ts, services/<name>.service.ts, repositories/ (interfaces, the bundle, the registry, and a backend folder beside them), channels/ (the interface, the bundle, the registry, and a tier folder beside them), eventing/<feature>.pipeline.ts and what it names, rules/<name>.rules.ts, tasks/<name>.task.ts, migrations/.
  - fix: Move it to the directory matching its artifact suffix.

## `langwatch/feature-source-subject`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-feature-source-subject.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `foreignSubject`
  - what: Source module {{path}} claims {{subject}}, which belongs to the singular {{owner}} feature.
  - fix: Move the file into `modules/{{owner}}/…` (see the `feature-move` skill), or rename the subject if it is genuinely different.

## `langwatch/handled-error-outside-contract`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: applies
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-handled-error-outside-contract.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `handledError`
  - what: `{{name}}` extends `HandledError` in `{{path}}`.
  - fix: Move it to `{{errorsFile}}`.
  - why: A service throws it and a client reads its code, so both sides need the class and neither may import a server package.

## `langwatch/id-generation-origin`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: applies
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-id-generation-origin.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `foreignIdModule`
  - what: `{{name}}` mints ids outside the house scheme.
  - fix: Import `generate` from `@langwatch/ksuid` and prefix the kind: `agent_${generate()}`.
  - why: A second id scheme neither sorts by time nor names its kind, and two schemes in one table are a migration.
- `randomUuid`
  - what: `randomUUID()` mints an id outside the house scheme.
  - fix: Import `generate` from `@langwatch/ksuid` and prefix the kind: `agent_${generate()}`.
  - why: A UUID neither sorts by time nor names its kind, and two schemes in one table are a migration.

## `langwatch/layer-class`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: isOverengineeringFile
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-layer-class.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `deleteTheLayer`
  - what: {{message}}
  - fix: {{allowed}}
  - why: A pass-through class costs every reader a hop and every caller an indirection, and hides nothing.

## `langwatch/legacy-monolith-path`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-legacy-monolith-path.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `legacyMonolithPath`
  - what: `{{name}}` names the deleted monolith.
  - fix: Point it at the package that owns the code now - `modules/<feature>/{contract,server,web}`, `packages/<name>` or `apps/<app>`.
  - why: Nothing maps `~/*` and `platform/` is gone, so the path resolves to nothing until something reaches the file.

## `langwatch/logical-statement-spacing`

- Kind: layout
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: whitespace
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-logical-statement-spacing.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `chainGroupSpacing`
  - what: Each .{{opener}}(...) group in a chain starts after one blank line.
  - fix: Add a blank line before the group.
- `paragraphSpacing`
  - what: A statement that spans several lines stands alone: one blank line before and after it.
  - fix: Add a blank line.
- `statementSpacing`
  - what: Separate control-flow statements and non-sole return/throw statements with one blank line.
  - fix: Add a blank line.

## `langwatch/max-statements-per-line`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: applies
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-max-statements-per-line.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `maxStatementsPerLine`
  - what: Two statements share line {{line}}.
  - fix: Put each on its own line.

## `langwatch/module-app-only-across-packages`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: none yet

Options: none.

Messages:

- `reachThroughApi`
  - what: `{{name}}` reaches `{{module}}`'s server package directly.
  - fix: Reach {{module}} through its contract Api token; a module is its App outside its package.

## `langwatch/namespace-class`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: applies
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-namespace-class.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `namespaceClass`
  - what: `{{name}}` has only static members ({{count}}), so it is a module wearing a class.
  - fix: Export the functions from a `rules/` module and delete the class.
  - why: A class earns its name by holding state; a bag of statics hides plain functions behind a namespace and a `create` nobody calls.

## `langwatch/no-boot-hook-outside-guard`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-no-boot-hook-outside-guard.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `bootHookOutsideGuard`

## `langwatch/no-logger-spy`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-no-logger-spy.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `spyOnLogger`
  - what: `vi.spyOn` patches a real logger here.
  - fix: Inject `createTestLogger()` from `@langwatch/test-harness` and assert on `lines.find` instead.

## `langwatch/no-port-vocabulary`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: none yet

Options: none.

Messages:

- `portFile`
  - what: `{{name}}` is a port file.
  - fix: Move it to repositories/, channels/, services/ or the module's Infrastructure and give it the name of its role.
- `portVocabulary`
  - what: `{{name}}` names a port.
  - fix: Name the role instead. Owned state is a repository, messages to something the module does not own are a channel, a client the process supplies is a member of the module's Infrastructure, behaviour is a service.

## `langwatch/no-prototype-stub`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-no-prototype-stub.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `prototypeStub`
  - what: `Object.create({{name}}.prototype)` builds a test double from a class prototype.
  - fix: Build the stub as an object literal typed as the interface, or use the module fixture.

## `langwatch/no-raw-error-output`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-no-raw-error-output.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `rawErrorOutput`
  - what: `{{call}}` dumps `{{name}}` straight to the console.
  - fix: Log through `createLogger` with the error as a field instead of a raw console dump.

## `langwatch/no-raw-hono-mount`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-no-raw-hono-mount.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `rawMount`
  - what: Mount through `app.access(policy)`; the raw Hono app skips the access policy.
  - fix: Register the route through `app.access(policy)` instead of `app.hono`.

## `langwatch/no-runtime-reflection`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-no-runtime-reflection.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `defineProperty`
  - what: `Object.defineProperty` patches an object that is not a class prototype.
  - fix: Declare the property on the class or the object literal instead of patching it in.
- `proxy`
  - what: `new Proxy(...)` stands in for a class here.
  - fix: Write the class or app the module already declares instead of intercepting it at runtime.
- `reflect`
  - what: `Reflect.{{member}}` reaches around a method call.
  - fix: Call the method directly; add it to the interface if it is missing.

## `langwatch/overload-by-literal`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: isOverengineeringFile
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-overload-by-literal.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `splitTheOverloads`
  - what: {{message}}
  - fix: {{allowed}}
  - why: An overload set that only flips a flag makes the reader diff two signatures to learn one thing.

## `langwatch/package-boundaries`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-package-boundaries.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `compositionRoot`
  - what: Only a composition root (`apps/api`, `apps/worker`, `apps/tasks`, `enterprise/packages/composition/*`) may import a feature server package.
  - fix: Import the feature's contract package here, or move this wiring into the composition root.
- `contractRuntime`
  - what: A contract package is transport-neutral: `{{specifier}}` is a node/browser/server runtime.
  - fix: Move this code to the server or web package and keep only types and schemas here.
- `coreImportsEnterprise`
  - what: Core code cannot import enterprise packages.
  - fix: Register the enterprise implementation through the composition root instead.
- `crossFeature`
  - what: `{{specifier}}` is another feature's server or web package.
  - fix: Import the same capability from `@langwatch/{{feature}}-contract`; if it is not exported there, add it to the contract first.
- `deadAlias`
  - what: `{{specifier}}` is a deleted alias (`~/`, `@app/`, `@ee/`).
  - fix: Import the module by its package name.
- `featureLayer`
  - what: `{{layer}}` cannot import `{{targetLayer}}`.
  - fix: Depend on the port or service instead and let the composition root supply the concrete adapter.
- `packageEscape`
  - what: This relative import leaves `{{packageRoot}}`.
  - fix: Import the target by its package name, or move the module into this package.
- `prismaContainment`
  - what: Prisma may be imported only by a server repository adapter under src/repositories/prisma.
  - fix: Move the query into a `*.repository.ts` there and call it through the service.
- `retiredPackageRuntime`
  - what: This package entry point belongs to a retired runtime or package surface.
  - fix: Use {{replacement}} instead.
- `schemaBoundary`
  - what: `{{specifier}}` binds the contract to Hono.
  - fix: Export a plain Zod/Standard Schema and let the transport adapt it.
- `sealedExports`
  - what: `{{subpath}}` is not in `{{package}}`'s `exports`.
  - fix: Import from a declared entry, or add the subpath to that package's `exports` if it is meant to be public.
- `serverImportsBrowser`
  - what: A server package cannot import `{{specifier}}` (browser).
  - fix: Move the browser-only value to the web package.
- `webImportsServer`
  - what: A web package cannot import a server package.
  - fix: Call the API the server exposes, or import the type from the contract.

## `langwatch/plan-literals`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: isPlanFactSource
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-plan-literals.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `statesPlanFacts`
  - what: {{name}} states {{fields}} itself.
  - fix: Read them from the catalogue: `planCatalogue.plan("<TYPE>").limits` from @langwatch/plans. If this is a fixture, build it from `planCatalogue.plan(...)` and override the one field the test is about.
  - why: An object assigning two or more limit fields is a plan definition, and there is one catalogue of those.

## `langwatch/prisma-containment`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-prisma-containment.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `featurePrismaClient`
  - what: Feature packages cannot own Prisma connection or lifecycle services.
  - fix: Import `PrismaClient` as a type only and take the instance from the composition root; features do not own connections.
- `generatedPrisma`
  - what: Generated Prisma may only be imported by a repository under server/src/repositories/prisma or the Postgres composition adapter (server/src/adapters/postgres.<subject>.adapter.ts).
  - fix: Move the query into a `*.repository.ts` there and call it through the service.

## `langwatch/refusal-is-a-handled-error`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: isServerTransport
- Fixable: no
- Spec: none yet

Options: none.

Messages:

- `handWrittenRefusal`
  - what: A refusal is written as a status and a body ({{shape}}).
  - fix: Throw a `HandledError` with a stable code and let the boundary render it, and give that code an entry in `packages/handled-error/src/presentation.ts` so the customer reads words instead of the slug.
  - why: Nothing hand-rendered reaches the error boundary, so the answer carries no code: the client presentation registry has nothing to key the customer's words on, and a test can only assert prose that will change.

## `langwatch/repository-takes-only-its-store`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: isRepository
- Fixable: no
- Spec: none yet

Options: none.

Messages:

- `repositoryTakesMoreThanItsStore`
  - what: A repository names {{crossed}} (`{{specifier}}`).
  - fix: Move the decision into the service that calls this repository, and keep the repository over its store alone.
  - why: A repository takes the store it reads and nothing else. Behaviour lives in the service and the app above it, and outside its own package a module is its App.

## `langwatch/schema-outside-contract`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: isSchemaSource
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-schema-outside-contract.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `schema`
  - what: `{{name}}` is a Zod schema declared in `{{path}}`.
  - fix: Move it to `{{contractPath}}` and import it here.
  - why: A transport file declares routes and imports its shapes; the vocabulary belongs to every side of the wire.

## `langwatch/secrets-through-source`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-secrets-through-source.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `secret`
  - what: `{{key}}` is a classified secret and is read straight from the environment here.
  - fix: Resolve it through the SecretSource chain at the boot seam and pass the typed value in.
  - why: A secret read directly skips classification, the source chain and log redaction.

## `langwatch/service-classes`

- Kind: style
- Applies to: applies
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-service-classes.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `create`
  - what: A service class must expose construction through a static create method.
  - fix: Add a static `create` method and make the constructor private.
- `missing`
  - what: A service module must define a class whose name ends in Service.
  - fix: Export a `*Service` class from this module.
- `standalone`
  - what: Exported function `{{name}}` in a service module: make it a method on the `*Service` class, or a private module-level helper (not exported).
  - fix: Move the behaviour onto the class, or stop exporting the helper.

## `langwatch/service-dependencies`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-service-dependencies.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `databaseClient`
  - what: A service cannot import a database client; persistence belongs behind its own repository.
  - fix: Move the import behind a `*.repository.ts` and depend on that instead.
- `foreignRepository`
  - what: `{{specifier}}` is another subject's repository.
  - fix: Depend on that subject's service instead; a service owns only its own repository.
- `globalApplication`
  - what: A service cannot recover the global application graph.
  - fix: Inject the service dependency explicitly.

## `langwatch/service-does-not-open-a-channel`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: isService
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-service-does-not-open-a-channel.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `serviceOpensAChannel`
  - what: A service opens {{conduit}} directly (`{{specifier}}`).
  - fix: Move the conduit to `channels/<tier>/<tier>.<subject>.channel.ts` and inject the channel interface.
  - why: Messages to or from something the module does not own are a channel: an interface the module names, a live implementation per tier and a memory twin a test asserts against.

## `langwatch/service-loads-its-own-config`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: applies
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-service-loads-its-own-config.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `configFunction`
  - what: `{{name}}` in `{{path}}` resolves its own configuration.
  - fix: Delete it; add a named `config` member to the argument object `create` takes and resolve it once at the composition root.
  - why: A caller that already validated its config forces every callee to re-validate what it was handed.
- `environmentRead`
  - what: `{{path}}` reads `process.env.{{key}}` directly instead of taking config as an argument.
  - fix: Add a named member to the argument object `create` takes and resolve it once at the composition root.
  - why: A caller that already validated its config forces every callee to re-validate what it was handed.

## `langwatch/service-member-spacing`

- Kind: layout
- Applies to: applies
- Fixable: whitespace
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-service-member-spacing.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `memberSpacing`
  - what: Consecutive service methods, constructors, and accessors need one blank line between them.
  - fix: Add a blank line.

## `langwatch/service-quality`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: applies
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-service-quality.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `duplicateMember`
  - what: A service class cannot declare the member {{name}} more than once.
  - fix: Remove or rename one of the declarations.
- `duplicateObjectKey`
  - what: A service object literal cannot declare the key {{name}} more than once.
  - fix: Remove or rename one of the keys.
- `publicConstructor`
  - what: `{{name}}` has `static create`, so its constructor must be `private` so callers cannot bypass it.
  - fix: Mark the constructor `private`.

## `langwatch/stand-in-cast`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: isGovernedSource
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-stand-in-cast.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `anyCast`
  - what: `as any` drops the type of this expression.
  - fix: Name the real type, or parse the value at the seam with the contract's schema.
- `doubleCast`
  - what: `as {{through}} as {{target}}` casts through {{through}} to reach {{target}}.
  - fix: Give the value the type it really has, or parse it at the seam with the contract's schema.
  - why: A cast through `unknown` or `any` removes the only check that stood between the two types.

## `langwatch/temporal-only`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: isTemporalOnlySource
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-temporal-only.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `constructInstant`
  - what: {{name}} builds a Date out of a value.
  - fix: Use `Temporal.Instant.from(iso)` for an ISO string, `Temporal.Instant.fromEpochMilliseconds(ms)` for a millisecond count, or `fromDate(date)` from @langwatch/time when a boundary handed you a Date.
- `dateType`
  - what: {{name}} is typed `Date`.
  - fix: Declare it `Temporal.Instant` from @langwatch/time, or `string` when the value only ever comes off the wire, and convert with `toDate()` at the Prisma or SDK boundary.
  - why: A Date on a declared type invites one to be minted to satisfy it.
- `mintNow`
  - what: {{name}} mints a Date for the current moment.
  - fix: Call `nowInstant()` from @langwatch/time.
  - why: One clock: every moment in the product is a Temporal.Instant.
- `mintNowMilliseconds`
  - what: {{name}} reads the current moment as Date epoch milliseconds.
  - fix: Call `nowInstant().epochMilliseconds` from @langwatch/time.
- `parseInstant`
  - what: {{name}} parses a moment through Date.
  - fix: Use `Temporal.Instant.from(iso).epochMilliseconds` from @langwatch/time.
- `utcInstant`
  - what: {{name}} builds an epoch count out of calendar parts through Date.
  - fix: Build the moment with `Temporal.PlainDateTime.from({ year, month, day }).toZonedDateTime("UTC").epochMilliseconds` from @langwatch/time.

## `langwatch/transport-imports-a-repository`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: isTransportDeclaration
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-transport-imports-a-repository.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `repositoryFolder`
  - what: `{{specifier}}` reaches the module's `repositories/` folder from a transport file.
  - fix: Call the module's app instead; the app owns the guards, the tenancy filter and the authz decision.
- `repositoryModule`
  - what: `{{specifier}}` is a repository module imported from a transport file.
  - fix: Call the module's app instead; the app owns the guards, the tenancy filter and the authz decision.
- `repositoryName`
  - what: `{{name}}` is a repository held as a value in a transport file.
  - fix: Take the module's app as the dependency and call a service method on it.

## `langwatch/transport-middleware-is-a-gate`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-transport-middleware-is-a-gate.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `functionMember`
  - what: Middleware fact field `{{field}}` is function-typed.
  - fix: Drop this field and call the method on the module's app instead; a middleware fact never carries a function.
- `reservedName`
  - what: Middleware fact `{{name}}` is named like a capability, not a gate.
  - fix: Make this a method on the module's app; a middleware fact carries only credentials, audit, rate limits or body format.

## `langwatch/type-only-value-import`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-type-only-value-import.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `valueImportOfType`
  - what: `{{name}}` is imported as a value here, but its declaration in `{{specifier}}` is a type or interface.
  - fix: Import it with `import type` instead.

## `langwatch/typed-prisma-seam`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-typed-prisma-seam.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `cast`
  - what: `as PrismaClient` is not permitted.
  - fix: The composition adapter takes a typed PrismaClient and hands it to the repository.
- `databaseObject`
  - what: `database: object` in a `.create(` argument list forces a cast at the seam.
  - fix: Type the parameter as PrismaClient and take it from the composition root.

## `langwatch/unbounded-loop`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: applies
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-unbounded-loop.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `unboundedLoop`
  - what: This `{{form}}` loop states no exit condition in its header.
  - fix: Put the deadline or the retry budget in the header, or move the waiting into a method whose signature carries it.
  - why: When the exit lives in the body the reader has to find every return, break and throw to know when the loop ends.

## `langwatch/web-imports-server-shaped-value`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: applies
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-web-imports-server-shaped-value.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `serverShaped`
  - what: A browser module value-imports `{{name}}`, whose declarations are the server's and pull a database graph into the browser program.
  - fix: Import it as a type only, or reach the capability through a first-party module that the browser already owns.
  - why: Loading declaration files is the largest bucket in a type-check, and this class of import is invisible in the bundle.

## `langwatch/zod-object-composition`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: isSchemaSource
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-zod-object-composition.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `keepRefinements`
  - what: This Zod object carries refinements before .{{method}}().
  - fix: Use .safeExtend() to retain refinements, or apply the refinements to the final composed object.
  - why: Spreading its shape alone would discard those checks.
- `spreadShape`
  - what: Zod .{{method}}() composes object types through mapped generics.
  - fix: Compose with z.object({ ...base.shape, ...fields }); preserve strictness and catchalls with the matching object constructor and .catchall(). Use .safeExtend() when refinement or assignability checks must be retained.
  - why: Shape spreads avoid repeated generic instantiation when constructing derived schemas.
